architecture.approach: Ship the floor before new features. Extract four accessibility primitives (focus trap, visually hidden text, skip link, live region) into one module, adopt them screen by screen across the five reference pages, enforce contrast and reduced-motion in the shared stylesheet, then bring the event page inside an explicit performance budget and wire axe-core plus Lighthouse as non-interactive gates. No schema, API, or Convex change is involved.

components.name: components/a11y/focus-trap.tsx
components.description: Traps Tab within a container, restores focus to the invoking element on close, and falls back to main when the trigger is gone.

resolution.reason: @base-ui/react Dialog already traps focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus to its trigger, so a second focus-trap implementation would duplicate it.

components.name: components/a11y/visually-hidden.tsx
components.description: Screen-reader-only text for icon buttons, counters, and contextual labels.

components.name: components/a11y/live-region.tsx
components.description: Provider plus hook that announce polite or assertive async outcomes without moving focus.

components.name: components/a11y/skip-link.tsx
components.description: First focusable element on every page, targeting the main landmark.

components.name: lib/a11y/focus.ts
components.description: Focus helpers: remember/restore trigger, move focus to the first invalid field, and resolve a safe fallback target.

components.name: app/layout.tsx
components.description: Render the skip link and the header, main, and footer landmarks once for every page.

components.name: app/page.tsx
components.description: Home page: keyboard-operable cards, reduced-motion carousel, one h1, and labelled sections.

components.name: app/(public)/events/[slug]/page.tsx
components.description: Event page: performance shell, hero sizing, contrast and focus, single h1.

components.name: app/(public)/events/[slug]/_components/register-modal.tsx
components.description: Registration form: programmatic labels, aria-describedby for hints and errors, focus to the first invalid field.

components.name: components/event-card.tsx
components.description: Card link and actions keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring and an accessible name.

components.name: components/ui/dialog.tsx
components.description: Adopt FocusTrap so every dialog shares focus entry, trapping, Escape, and return behaviour.

components.name: components/ui/select.tsx
components.description: Arrow-key movement, Home/End, Escape, and an announced active option.

components.name: app/globals.css
components.description: Focus-visible ring token, reduced-motion media query, and contrast token corrections.

components.name: test/a11y/axe.test.tsx
components.description: axe-core run over the five reference pages, failing on any WCAG 2.1 A/AA violation.

resolution.reason: Test authoring belongs to /sdrive:test; the axe-core reference-page suite is deferred to that agent.

components.name: .lighthouserc.json
components.description: Lighthouse budget for the event page: performance and accessibility at least 95, LCP 2500ms, CLS 0.1, TBT 200ms.

components.name: lib/a11y/use-prefers-reduced-motion.ts
components.description: Reactive prefers-reduced-motion hook so JS-driven motion (carousel autoplay) can be disabled, not just CSS transitions.

dataModel.flowDescription: No persistence, schema, or API change. The feature changes presentation, focus management, and the client bundle of existing pages.

securityConsiderations.description: Announced and visually-hidden text render as text; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML is introduced (CON-517).
Existing CSP and security headers are untouched; no inline script or style is added that would require relaxing them (CON-513, CON-520).
Form validation stays Zod plus Convex validators; the feature only connects messages to inputs (CON-515).

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Event page Lighthouse mobile performance and accessibility at least 95, LCP at most 2.5s, CLS at most 0.1, TBT at most 200ms on a 4x CPU / 1.6 Mbps profile against the production build.
First-load JavaScript at or below 180KB gzip; interactive islands behind client boundaries and dynamic imports.
next/image with explicit dimensions and priority for the hero; display swap with metric-compatible fallbacks for fonts.

risks.description: Accessibility work is invisible in a demo and gets deprioritised.
risks.mitigation: Implement the automated gates in the same change so regressions fail the build.

risks.description: Lighthouse results are noisy across machines.
risks.mitigation: Pin the mobile profile, measure the production build, and assert budgets rather than a single score.

risks.description: Changing every dialog at once risks the registration and ticket flows.
risks.mitigation: Adopt FocusTrap screen by screen, keeping the existing suites green.
